string.text: Weaver Mount Type 1
Designed for installation of a tactical flashlight and laser target designator.Due to its configuration, it is not suitable for mounting sights and tactical grips.
Laser pointer

Visually indicates the location of the intended hit on the target, greatly facilitating and speeding up aiming, as well as having a demoralizing effect on the victim.Does not interfere with the installation of a tactical flashlight and can be used in conjunction with it.
Tactical flashlight

A narrow-beam, long-range flashlight is indispensable for night forays, as well as when exploring unlit areas.Does not interfere with the installation of a laser pointer and can be used in conjunction with it.
Weaver Mount Type 2
Allows the installation of a tactical grip, as well as additional types of sights.Not suitable for mounting laser designators and tactical flashlights.
Tactical grip
Installing an under-barrel grip allows you to make the weapon more convenient to handle, making it easier to compensate for recoil.
Replacing the magazine
Installing a high-capacity magazine (20 rounds) can significantly reduce the number of reloads in battle and thereby increase the chances of hitting the enemy.
Lightweight parts
Replacing weapon parts with their lighter counterparts allows you to reduce the weight of the weapon.
USM calibration
Individual fitting and balancing of standard parts of the firing mechanism allows for higher shooting accuracy while reducing recoil.
Forcing USM
Thanks to the replacement of trigger units, the weapon's rate of fire increases at the cost of a slight decrease in wear resistance.
Barrel adjustment
Allows you to reduce the spread of bullets when firing a weapon, which increases the accuracy and accuracy of fire.
Butt pad
Allows you to reduce the perceived recoil from a weapon shot.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Re-rifling the barrel
Changing the pitch of the rifling in the bore of a weapon allows you to increase the initial speed of the bullet and reduce the spread of hits when firing.
